name: Vaasa
title: The Frozen Land: Vaasa
description: A desolate, frozen land dominated by the Castle Perilous and the legacy of the Lich-King Zhengyi.
wiki: Vaasa is a harsh and cold land in northeast Faerûn. It is a place of desolate moors, frozen tundras, and jagged mountains. For centuries, it was the seat of power for the Witch-King Zhengyi, who ruled from the Castle Perilous. Even after his fall, the land remains scarred by his dark magic and inhabited by his former servants.
